hints: Build an ordering position by position. What are the choices for the first position, and what changes for the second?
Any unused value can go first, and then the same question is asked of the remaining ones - so the branching factor falls by one at each level.
Track which values are still unused, choose one, recurse, and then mark it unused again on the way back.
The other version swaps the chosen value into place instead of keeping a used-flags list, which needs no extra memory - and the undo is the same swap done again.
